text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: One day, a few days after Sheffy's revival, due to Pecorine's official duties, the members of the Gourmet Guild had temporarily returned to Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィが復活して数日が経った、ある日のこと。
ぺコリーヌの公務の都合もあり、
【美食殿】の一同はランドソルに一時帰還していた。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: As for {0}, he was strolling through the city with Sheffy, who said she wanted to see the "reconstructed" Landosol, and so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そして{0}はというと、
「再構築されたランドソルを見たい」というシェフィと共に
街を散策していたのだが──

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: And with that... it's 10 tails! I think we're almost done packing up this batch.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで……
10尾め！
イレギュラー分はそろそろ終わりかしら。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: If we keep up this pace, we'll be done and go ahead with the deliveries soon. This takes me back, freezing tunnus just like this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この調子なら、
もうすぐ終わりそうね。
懐かしいわ、
冷凍ツナトゥンヌス作り！

text_block_list.name: Cabman
text_block_list.text: Man, you two really saved me! Recently, my catches of Tunnus have been so good that I was having trouble carrying it all around town intact. Doing this alone would've been impossible.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやー、
二人ともほんと助かったよ！
最近トゥンヌスが豊漁過ぎて、
運ぶのに困ってたんだ。
一人でやるにもさすがに骨が折れてさ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: This is my former part-time job, after all. I'm glad I could be of help.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これでも元バイトだもの。
役に立ててよかったわ。

text_block_list.name: Cabman
text_block_list.text: Don't say "former", I'm happy you came back! Everyone back in my guild also missed you a lot, Sheffy. You're always trying your hardest, and you're also reliable.
text_block_list.orig_text:
元と言わず、
また戻ってきてよ！
ギルドのみんなも
シェフィちゃんが恋しいって言ってるんだ。
いつも一生懸命だし、
頼りになるし。

text_block_list.name: Cabman
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm very glad to see you've been doing well Sheffy. I've heard from {0} there that you had some issues back home and couldn't be around, so I was pretty worried about you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしても、
シェフィちゃんが元気そうでよかったよ。
実家のほうが大変だって兄ちゃんたちから聞いてたから
これでもけっこう心配してたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Huh? {0} and the others said that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
{0}たちがそんなことを？

text_block_list.name: Cabman
text_block_list.text: Yeah. But they also said that once things had calmed down, you'd surely come back, and here you are.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ。
だけど
落ち着いたら
きっと帰ってくるからって、
な。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I might have disappeared for good, so why... Maybe you said that so you wouldn't create unnecessary trouble? So that when I came back, I could help out everyone again...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は消えてたかもしれないのに、
どうして……
もしかして、
私が困らないように言ってくれたの？
戻ってこれたとき、
またお手伝いができるように……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: ...Geez. Everyone truly is so overprotective.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……もう。
みんな、
本当に過保護なんだから。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right. Things haven't exactly settled down just yet actually. But now I'm back, so don't worry.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
そうね。
まだ完全に落ち着いたわけじゃないけど。
でも、
ひとまず帰ってこれたから大丈夫よ。

text_block_list.name: Cabman
text_block_list.text: If there's anything you need help with, just let me know. Me and my guild will do anything we can to help.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんか困ったことがあったら
言ってくれよ。
できることがあれば
いくらでも手伝うからさ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank you. Next up, we'll deliver the packages to where they need to go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
ありがとう。
それじゃ、
次は向こうの荷物を届けてくるわね！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: It's a strange feeling. It's like I haven't been home in years. I've missed it so much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
不思議な感じだわ。
まるで何年も帰ってなかったみたいに
懐かしくてたまらないの。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: This bulletin board too... I first looked for part-time work here. It was a tough time back then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この掲示板も……
最初はここでお仕事を探したのよね。
あのときは大変だったわ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: That's right! I was so impatient with the orders that I tripped, made the cat angry, and even got in the way of a carriage... I made so many mistakes that I was about to lose confidence. But it was fun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうそう！　
注文に焦って転んだり、
猫を怒らせちゃったり、
馬車の邪魔まで……
失敗ばかりで、
本当に自信を無くすところだったわ。
でも、
楽しかった。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: ...Actually, to be honest... Before returning here to Landosol, I was a bit worried. Worried that the world had been "reconstructed" and turned into something completely different from what I remember.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……実はね。
ランドソルに来るまで、
ちょっと不安だったの。
世界が再構築されて、
全然知らない場所になってたら
どうしようって。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: But... now I'm a little relieved. The world has been indeed "reconstructed", at least on the surface, but it's like how it used to be. Thank goodness...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
ちょっとホッとしたわ。
世界は一応、
表面だけでも昔通りに造りなおされたのね。
よかった……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, I almost walked too far compared to where we were supposed to deliver. The next package is to be delivered here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……って、
おしゃべりしてたら行きすぎるところだったわ。
次の荷物の配達先は
ここよね。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Hello! We have a delivery for you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんにちは！　
お届け物です！

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text: If it isn't Sheffy! Long time no see. How've you been?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらシェフィちゃん！
久しぶりね、
元気だった？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: It's been a while. Do you remember about me...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お久しぶりです。
私のこと、
覚えててくれたの……？

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text: Don't underestimate the memory of the elderly. You used to come and deliver packages to me from time to time. I hadn't seen you at all recently so I was worried.
text_block_list.orig_text:
年寄りの記憶力を舐めちゃだめよぉ。
ときどき荷物を届けに来てくれてたでしょ。
最近見なかったから心配してたの。

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text: Come in, come in, why don't you enter and take a break? I'm so glad to see you here! That reminds me, I also have some delicious sweets!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁさぁ、
よかったら上がって
一休みしていって！
あなたが来てくれてうれしいわぁ！
そうだ、
ちょうど美味しいお菓子があるのよ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: After that, the two continued to deliver frozen Tunnus, and Sheffy was welcomed back by different people wherever they went.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その後も二人は冷凍トゥンヌスの配達を続け、
シェフィは行く先々で人々に歓迎された。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I'm surprised... I only helped out with deliveries whenever your workplace needed extra help, but everyone still remembered me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
驚いたわ……
配達は手が足りないときしか手伝ってなかったのに
みんな私を覚えてくれてたなんて。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I was just desperate to make some money. ...But, yeah, you're right. I guess it was worth the effort.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私はただ、
お金を稼がなきゃって必死になってただけよ。
……でも、
そうね。
頑張った甲斐はあったってことかしら。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Besides, if I had continued to sleep forever, I might never have been able to see those people again. That thought... makes me very happy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに、
もし私があのまま眠っていたら
あの人たちとも、
もう会えなかったかもしれない。
そう思うと……
とってもうれしいわ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: ...Umm, the last delivery place is this restaurant. This place offers a delicious Tunnus cutlet burger. The manager said it was his specialty.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……えっと、
最後の配達場所はこのレストランね。
ここ、
トゥンヌスのカツバーガーが美味しいのよ。
店長考案の自慢の味って言ってたわ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I'm also part of the Gourmets, after all. ...Or that's what I'd like to say, but the last time I delivered something here, he just offered me some for lunch.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私だって
【美食殿】だもの。
……って
言いたいところだけど。
前に配達したとき、
お昼にどうぞって貰ったの。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: The manager is really friendly, and the staff are nice too. I wonder if they're still doing well... Excuse me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すっごく気さくな店長さんで、
店員さんもいい人なのよ。
元気にしてるかしら……
ごめんくださーい！

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, the number of tunnus you've brought is perfect. Thanks a lot, Sheffy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うん、
トゥンヌスの数はバッチリだ。
ありがとね、
シェフィちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Then please I'll have your signature over here. ...Hey, by the way, is Manager Genzou absent today? I can't see him anywhere...
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあこっちにサインをお願い。
……ねぇ、
ところで
今日
店長のゲンゾウさんって
お休みなの？
姿が見えないようだけど……

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: Genzou-san, huh...? Hmm, I didn't expect you to bring up that name too, Sheffy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゲンゾウさん、
かぁ……
うーん、
まさかシェフィちゃんからも
その名前が出るとはなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: Another customer had asked me before, "How is Genzo doing?". But there's no record of anyone named Genzo living back at my house and I don't remember anyone by that name being employed here either, so I was just left flabbergasted about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
前にも別のお客さんから
「ゲンゾウさんは元気か」って聞かれてさ。
でも
ゲンゾウなんて人、
うちにいた記録がないし
僕も雇われた記憶がないから、
不思議に思ってたんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: B-But I was definitely delivering to Genzo-san, right? At that time, I heard that the tunnus burger here was his specialty dish, that it was a menu item he had thought up, and he wanted me to give it a chance and try it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
でも私、
確かにゲンゾウさんに配達していたのよ？
そのときに
ここのバーガーが自慢の料理だって、
俺が考えたメニューなんだって話を聞いて、
食べさせてもらって……

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: I see... I wonder what's going on. I've been working at this restaurant for a long time, but I really don't have any memories of this Genzo-san. However I can't really believe you'd be lying either, Sheffy, so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうか……
一体どういうことなんだろうなぁ。
僕もこの店で働いて長いけど、
ゲンゾウさんの記憶は本当にないんだ。
でも
シェフィちゃんが嘘をつくとは思えないし。

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: ...Actually now that you mention it, I don't know who came up with that burger. One day, the recipe and menu suddenly appeared in the restaurant. Such a mysterious dish.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……実はさ、
あのバーガーは
考案者不明なんだよ。
ある日いつの間にか
店にレシピとメニューが存在してた、
摩訶不思議な料理なんだ。

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: If you think about it like that, it's strange how it came about to be in the first place, so it wouldn't be strange if one or two additional strange things are also happening around here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう考えると、
そもそも成り立ちが不思議だし
変なことの一つや二つ、
追加で起きてもおかしくはないかもな。

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: Besides, it doesn't change the fact that our tunnus burgers are the best! So, you two, feel free to have one if you like. Tired from all that Tunnus delivery, right? And it's on me, no charge!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに
うちのバーガーが最高だってことには変わりないし！
てことで二人とも、
よかったら食べてってくれよ。
トゥンヌスの配達で疲れただろ？　
お代はいらないからさ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: S-Sure...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
ええ……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: That's strange... I definitely heard from the manager that he came up with the tunnus burger sold here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかしいわ……
私、
店長から確かに聞いたのよ。
ここのバーガーは自分が考えたって。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe that's why. There was a lot of damage done in the battle against Eris and the others....
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうかもしれないわね。
エリスたちとの戦いで、
たくさんの被害が出てしまったわけだし……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: And... if he's really a "Lost"...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに……
もしロストしてたなら……

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Haaah, I'm so glad, SO GLAD! I was able to buy it today before they sold out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はー
よかったよかったァ！
今日は売り切れる前に買えたぜ！

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: Let's hurry up and eat, bro! I'm so hungry!
text_block_list.orig_text:
早く食べようぜ兄貴！
オレもう腹空いてたまんねぇっス！

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Hagh, agh... Pwah! It's so good! I just can't end my work day shift without having this burger!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぐっ、
あぐっ……
っぷはぁ！　
うっめえ！
やっぱ仕事終わりはこのバーガーでなくちゃなァ！

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: But this burger is truly a mystery, isn't it? This burger is called the "Manager's Special Burger", but the store seems to be run by that sole clerk the entire time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
不思議っスよね、
このバーガー
『店長特製バーガー』なんて名前はついてるけど
ここって
あの店員がずっと一人でやってるじゃないスか。

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, the other day, some customer said that "Genzo-san is the manager here". But I don't remember anyone by that name around here tough.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういや前、
他の客が
「ゲンゾウさんが店長」とか言ってたぜ。
俺はそんな奴記憶にないけどなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: If even you don't know him bro, then who the hell is this Genzou-san...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
兄貴の記憶にないなら
その『ゲンゾウさん』って人は一体……？

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Well, there's no real point in sweating the small stuff! No matter who's making it, the burgers here are just GOOD! Right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ細かいことはいいんだよ！
誰が作ってようと、
ここのバーガーがウマいのは同じだ！
だろ？

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: Well, that's true! It's rude to think about unnecessary things while eating delicious food!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ
そっスね！
美味い飯を食うのに、
要らんこと考えるのは野暮っス！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: ...Now that I think about it, it makes sense. The forced logout was just to avoid the worst case scenario. Those who were "Lost" won't magically come back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……思えば、
わかってたことだわ。
強制ログアウトは、
あくまで最悪の事態を避けただけ。
ロストした人までは戻ってこない。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Besides, the two from earlier... no, everyone I met today. If they all aren't NPCs, then that means they are people who couldn't log out of this world... right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに、
さっきの二人組だって……
ううん、
今日会った人全員。
NPCじゃなかったとしたら、
この世界からログアウトできなかった人ってこと……
よね。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: ...I, too, was once wiped out from this world. But everyone helped me, and remembered me. I'm the only one who was lucky enough to be saved...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私も、
一度は消滅してしまった身だけど。
みんなに助けてもらって、
覚えててもらって。
私ばっかり、
こんな……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: ...It’s not like everything’s back to normal. So why was I... so excited? There are still so many people in this world who have become "Lost" without anyone realizing anything...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……全部が全部、
元通りになったわけじゃない。
なのに、
私……
なんで浮かれてたんだろう。
この世界には、
何もわからず失ってる人がまだたくさんいるのに……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. Umm. Sorry, I was just thinking about something. What's wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あっ。
ええと。
ごめんなさい、
少し考え事してただけよ。
どうかしたの？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Eh? Huh? Wait, where in the world are you g--...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
って
待って、
いったいどこに──

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Geez, he started pulling me so suddenly I couldn't help but wonder where he was taking me... Is that... a woman over there? She's frantically looking around. I wonder if she’s searching for something...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう、
急に引っ張るからどこに行くのかと思えば……
あそこにいるのは……
女の人？
辺りを見回してるけど、
何か探してるのかしら……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Oh my, you... you're the boy who's always helping me out, aren't you? Thank you for helping me look for him that time too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
貴方……
いつもお手伝いしてくれてる子よね。
あのときは一緒に探してくれてありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Not yet. Geez, he can be such a handful... Thanks to him, I've now got a lot of work to do at the guild.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それがまだなのよ。
まったくもう、
世話が焼けるんだから……
おかげでギルドの仕事が山積みよ。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Not to add even drinks post work have become boring now... Well, he used to not come home for a while before, so in that sense, I'm not too worried.
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕事終わりの一杯も味気ないし……
まぁ
彼ってば
昔もしばらく帰ってこなかったりしたから
そういう意味じゃ、
あまり心配はしてないんだけどね。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Haha, true enough. Thank you so much for worrying about me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
そうね。
気にしてくれて本当にありがとうね！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Hey, {0}. Could it be that "he" that the woman from earlier was looking for was...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
{0}。
さっきの女の人が捜してた「彼」って、
もしかして……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I knew that was the case! Thank goodness...
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱりそうなのね！
よかった……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: That woman just said that she has a recollection of his past movements... People who become "Lost" are also erased from everyone's records, so... I hope that man is safe back in our original world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっき、
女の人も
「足取りはわかった」って言ってたものね。
ロストした人は記録からも消えてしまうから……
元の世界で
無事だと良いのだけど。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: ...That's right. Now that you mention it, that's objectively true. After all, I'm the one who logged everyone out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そう、
ね。
言われてみれば、
そうなるのよね。
だって、
私がログアウトさせたってことだもの。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: It feels a bit strange for me to say this, but I'm sure that "he" was one of the many lights that headed towards the Tower of Sol that fateful day...
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分で言うのは、
なんだか変な気もするけれど
『彼』もきっと、
あの日ソルの搭に向かっていった
たくさんの光の一つだった……

text_block_list.name: シェフィ
text_block_list.text:
…………
…ねぇ、
{0}。
少しだけ、
話を聞いてくれる？
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………
…ねぇ、
{0}。
少しだけ、
話を聞いてくれる？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: When I was carrying my luggage, I told you that I was a little worried before coming back to Landosol. I was worried about the world being "reconstructed" and that places known to me would become unknown.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、
荷物を運んでるとき
「ランドソルに来るまで、
ちょっと不安だった」
って言ったわよね。
世界が再構築されて、
全然知らない場所になってたらどうしよう
って。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I wasn't lying when I said that, nor about what I felt, but... I realized something today when I was walking around town. I... I didn't really understand anything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その気持ちに嘘はないけど……
今日、
街を歩いてみて気づいたの。
私……
本当のところは、
何もわかってなかったわ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Although the world has been remade on the surface, there are still many distorted places and many people trapped inside of it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
世界は表面的には造りなおされたけれど
まだ歪なところもたくさんあって、
囚われてる人もたくさんいる。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: But as you have just shown me, there are also many people whom we have reached out to and helped with the logout. More than just those in the Gourmet Guild and among those we know...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
あなたが見せてくれたように、
私たちの手が届いて、
助けられた人もたくさんいるのよね。
【美食殿】のみんなや、
顔見知りの人以外にも。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: ......I'm glad. Really. What I did wasn't in vain. I was able to save a lot of people.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……よかったわ。
本当に。
私のしたことが無駄じゃなくて。
ちゃんとたくさんの誰かを救えてて。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: {0}. I've... made up my mind.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}。
私、
決めたわ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: This time, I want to help those who are "Lost". The world has clearly regained its shape, but... in this "next time" I was given, I want to reach everyone's happy ending. Not this twisted end.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、
今度はロストした人たちを助けたい。
世界は一応形を取り戻したけど……
次こそは歪な形じゃない、
最高のハッピーエンドにしたいの。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I don't mind being called greedy. If there's anything I can do to help, I want to do it. It's sad to eat a meal without an important friend or family at the table.
text_block_list.orig_text:
欲張りって言われても構わないわ。
私にできることがあるなら、
それをしたい。
ご飯を食べるのに、
大事な仲間が欠けてるのは悲しいもの。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: And also... I too... There's someone I want to save.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに……
私も、
助けたい人がいるから。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Yes!
text_block_list.orig_text: ええ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Hey you two! How long are you going to stay in front of the entrance? Hurry up and get in!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたたち、
いつまで玄関前にいるのよ。
早く入んなさい！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Lady Pecorine is joining us today. The guild members will all be together for tonight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日はぺコリーヌさまも一緒でございます。
メンバー水入らず、
でございますね。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Delicious food is also at the table! Let's all eat together☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいしいごはんもできてますよ！
みんなで食べましょう☆

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Okaaaaay! Heehee, it seems I made everyone worry again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい！
ふふっ、
またみんなに心配かけちゃったわね。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Well then... Let's go home together. To our house.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃ……
一緒に帰りましょ。
私たちのお家に。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Sheffy and {0} set new goals for the future. Hand in hand, the two finally returned to where they belonged.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今後に向けて新たな目標を定めた
シェフィと{0}。
二人は手を取り合い、ようやく自らの居場所へと帰ったのだった。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I'm home♪
text_block_list.orig_text: ただいまっ♪
